page.overview:
What is Kurn?

{| class="navbox" style="float: left; border: 2px solid red; font-size: 80%; line-height: 140%; padding: 0em; margin: auto; background-color:#000000; background-repeat: repeat-x; align:center; width: 100%;"

WARNING! This page contains content that may be game mechanics and not actual lore }|}}}}|}}. Read at your own risk!

The Kurn was a quadrupedal creature native to LV-742.

Kurn were quadrupedal animals with a gray coloration. They featured several spikes around their shoulders, which could be used offensively. Kurn uttered a snarling sound when idle, and a snorting bark when on the attack. Kurn would also jump into conflicts happening nearby even if they were not attacked directly.
